{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH and completed status
filtered = df_clean[
    (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders among those reached
n_total = len(filtered)
n_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0

# Print the exact numbers produced by code
print(n_total)
print(n_converted)
print(conversion_rate)

# Final conversion rate rounded to 3 decimal places for the answer
print(round(conversion_rate, 3))"}
